SELECT shop.Name
FROM shop
JOIN (
    SELECT Shop_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT Employee_ID) AS emp_count
    FROM hiring
    GROUP BY Shop_ID
    ORDER BY emp_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS sub ON shop.Shop_ID = sub.Shop_ID;
FINAL SQL:
SELECT shop.Name
FROM shop
JOIN (
    SELECT Shop_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT Employee_ID) AS emp_count
    FROM hiring
    GROUP BY Shop_ID
    ORDER BY emp_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS sub ON shop.Shop_ID = sub.Shop_ID;
